passage: The security team detected repeated login attempts against employee accounts from a known bot network. Multi-factor authentication blocked every attempt, and there is no evidence of account access or data exposure. As a precaution, employees who have not changed passwords in the past year will be prompted to do so this week. No immediate action is required today.

keyPoints.text: Multi-factor authentication blocked all bot-network login attempts, with no breach or exposure.
Employees with passwords older than one year will be prompted to change them this week.
No immediate employee action is required today.

referenceAnswer: MFA blocked a bot attack with no breach; older employee passwords will be reset this week, with no action needed today.
